title: Delayed checks
intro: A fresh question days later shows what stayed with you. It never changes your progress; a miss just schedules a review.
startFailed: The check could not start. Nothing changed; try again.
noFresh: No unseen questions remain for this check.
outcome.missed: Last check missed: the next one comes a step sooner, not back to the start
outcome.unsure: You said you weren't sure yet: a review comes soon, with nothing lost
moved: moved to your next study day
days.anyDay: Checks can fall due on any day.
days.current: Checks fall due only on the days ticked below, in your time zone ({zone}).
days.hint: A check that would fall on another day waits for your next study day. It never comes earlier.
days.saved: Study days saved. Your next checks were moved to match.
days.failed: Your study days could not be saved. Nothing changed; try again.
